titulo: Using Large Language Models to Support Study Screening in Systematic Reviews
resumo: This paper presents an approach using large language models to assist researchers during the screening phase of systematic literature reviews. The proposed method classifies titles and abstracts according to predefined inclusion and exclusion criteria and provides explanations for each decision.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo utiliza modelos de linguagem para apoiar a triagem de estudos em revisões sistemáticas.

titulo: A Systematic Review of Artificial Intelligence in Healthcare
resumo: This paper presents a systematic review of studies on artificial intelligence applications in healthcare, analyzing trends, challenges, and future directions.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo fala sobre inteligência artificial e revisão sistemática.

titulo: Machine Learning for Crop Disease Detection
resumo: This paper proposes a machine learning model for detecting crop diseases from images collected in agricultural environments.
justificativa_aplicacao: O artigo trata de machine learning, mas não trata de revisões sistemáticas.
